{{Top|leg}}
'''Exploding stone''' was the name the [[Ixll]]s gave to their own, homemade weapon. Essentially black powder [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], they were stored in pouches around the neck of an Ixll and were one of the more advanced weapons they produced.
